title: Amazon KDP Updates in 2026 Authors Should Know
seoTitle: Amazon KDP Updates in 2026 Authors Should Know
description: Discover latest Amazon KDP updates in 2026, including royalty changes, AI disclosure rules, pricing, A+ Content, metadata, and Kindle Unlimited

blocks.text: Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) remains one of the most important platforms for independent authors in 2026. However, several KDP updates and policy changes are affecting how authors publish, price, market, and manage their books.
From expanded eBook royalty pricing to AI content disclosure, identity verification, A+ Content, and continued growth in Kindle Unlimited, authors have several important developments to understand.
If you publish books through Amazon KDP, these are the Amazon KDP updates authors should know in 2026.
What Are the Biggest Amazon KDP Updates in 2026?
The most important KDP updates in 2026 include:

items: The 70% eBook royalty price range has expanded.
AI-assisted content does not require disclosure.
Identity verification is being introduced for authors and publishers.
Authors can download manuscript and cover files directly from their KDP Bookshelf.
A+ Content provides additional opportunities to improve book detail pages.
Kindle Unlimited continues to generate substantial author earnings.
Metadata, keywords, categories, and pricing remain important tools for improving discoverability.

blocks.text: Let’s look at each update in more detail.
1. Amazon Expanded the 70% eBook Royalty Price Range
One of the most significant KDP pricing updates in 2026 affects eBook royalties.
Effective **July 7, 2026**, Amazon expanded the 70% royalty option price range on Amazon.com from **$2.99–$9.99 to $2.99–$12.99**. Equivalent changes apply to other KDP marketplaces.
This gives authors more flexibility when pricing higher-value eBooks.
For example, an author who previously wanted to price an eBook above $9.99 may now have the option to remain within the 70% royalty price band, assuming the book meets the applicable requirements.

**What authors should do:** Review the prices of existing eBooks and determine whether the expanded range makes a different pricing strategy worthwhile. Don’t increase prices simply because the maximum has changed; consider genre expectations, competing books, reader value, and conversion rates.
2. AI-Generated Content Must Be Disclosed
AI is one of the biggest changes affecting publishing in 2026.

Amazon requires authors to inform KDP when they publish a new book or republish an existing book containing AI-generated text, images, or translations. This includes AI-generated cover art and interior artwork.
Amazon distinguishes between **AI-generated** and **AI-assisted** content.
If an AI tool creates the actual text, image, or translation, Amazon considers it AI-generated even if the author substantially edits the result afterward.
By contrast, authors do not have to disclose AI-assisted content when they create the work themselves and use AI for tasks such as brainstorming, editing, refining, or proofreading.
Why Does This Matter?

Authors should keep accurate records of how AI tools are used during production. More importantly, using AI does not remove the author’s responsibility for copyright, intellectual property, accuracy, or KDP compliance.
Amazon states that authors remain responsible for ensuring AI-generated and AI-assisted content follows its guidelines.
3. Identity Verification Is Rolling Out
Another important development is identity verification for authors and publishers.
Amazon says it is beginning to ask authors and publishers to verify their identity as part of efforts to protect people who publish and purchase books on the platform.
For authors, this means keeping account information accurate and being prepared to complete verification if KDP requests it.
Authors should also be cautious of scams. KDP warns that it will not ask authors to provide sensitive information such as Amazon passwords or full banking details outside their KDP account.
4. KDP Bookshelf Now Offers Easier File Access
KDP has also introduced the ability to download eBook and print book manuscript and cover files directly from the KDP Bookshelf.
This can be useful for authors who need to:

items: Keep backup copies of their publishing files

blocks.text: Keeping your original manuscript, cover files, ISBN information, and final publishing files securely backed up remains a smart publishing practice.
5. A+ Content Gives Authors More Marketing Opportunities
A+ Content is another useful KDP marketing feature in 2026.

Authors can create enhanced content for eligible book detail pages through the **A+ Content Manager**. This allows publishers to add additional images, text, and modules designed to help readers understand the book.

Amazon also provides an AI-assisted A+ Content creation feature in certain circumstances. Currently, Amazon says the AI Ready feature is available in English in the United States. Authors remain responsible for reviewing generated content for accuracy and compliance.

6. Kindle Unlimited Continues to Be Important
Kindle Unlimited remains a major part of Amazon’s publishing ecosystem.
Amazon’s KDP pages report **$71 million in total KDP Select author earnings for July 2026**.
Authors enrolled in KDP Select can earn from pages read through Kindle Unlimited, making reader engagement an important consideration alongside individual eBook sales.
However, authors should evaluate KDP Select based on their own publishing strategy, including exclusivity requirements, readership, genre, and revenue goals.
7. Metadata Still Matters for Book Discoverability
KDP’s 2026 guidance continues to emphasize accurate metadata.

Book titles, subtitles, descriptions, keywords, categories, author information, and other metadata affect how books are presented and discovered on Amazon. Amazon specifically recommends using relevant keyword phrases and warns against misleading keywords or categories.
For example, authors should avoid adding unrelated popular authors, misleading claims, sales-rank terms, or promotional language to keyword fields.
A strong KDP SEO strategy should focus on reader intent rather than keyword stuffing.

blocks.text: 8. Authors Can Update Some Book Details After Publication
KDP allows authors to change several important details after publication, including descriptions, keywords, categories, territories, pricing, and certain other information.
However, some details are locked after publication.
For example, significant changes to a paperback or hardcover’s title, subtitle, or primary author name generally require a new edition after the initial 72-hour period.
This makes it important to carefully review your metadata before publishing.
9. Publishing and Update Timelines Still Matter
Authors should also plan around KDP processing times.

Amazon says books and updates generally take around **three business days** to become live, although specific processes can take longer. eBook search visibility may take up to 72 hours, while some features such as updated Read Sample content can take several business days.
Therefore, don’t wait until the day of a marketing campaign to change your book information.

What Should KDP Authors Do in 2026?
The best approach is to treat KDP as an evolving publishing platform rather than a one-time upload service.
Authors should review their pricing, metadata, AI disclosures, book files, A+ Content, and marketing strategy regularly.

Most importantly, focus on reader experience. Accurate descriptions, relevant keywords, professional covers, high-quality manuscripts, and appropriate categories remain fundamental to successful self-publishing.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the biggest Amazon KDP update in 2026?
One of the biggest changes is the expansion of the 70% eBook royalty price band to **$2.99–$12.99 on Amazon.com**, effective July 7, 2026.
Does Amazon KDP require authors to disclose AI-generated content?

Yes. KDP requires authors to disclose AI-generated text, images, and translations when publishing or republishing books. AI-assisted content does not require disclosure under Amazon’s current distinction.
Can authors still use AI for KDP books?
Yes, but authors must follow KDP’s AI content requirements and remain responsible for intellectual property rights, accuracy, and compliance.
Can I change my KDP book keywords after publishing?
Yes. Keywords can generally be updated after publication through your KDP Bookshelf. Amazon says updates may take approximately 72 hours to appear.
Is Kindle Unlimited still worthwhile in 2026?

It can be valuable for authors whose books perform well with Kindle Unlimited readers. Amazon reported $71 million in KDP Select author earnings for July 2026, demonstrating the continuing scale of the program.
Final Takeaway

The Amazon KDP updates authors should know in 2026 are largely centered around pricing flexibility, AI transparency, account verification, improved publishing tools, enhanced marketing features, and stronger attention to metadata and content quality.

For authors, the opportunity is not simply to publish more books. It is to publish better books, use accurate metadata, price strategically, follow AI policies, and build a stronger reader experience.
As KDP continues to evolve, authors who regularly review Amazon’s official policies and publishing tools will be better positioned to adapt to changes and make informed publishing decisions in 2026.
